Do AI agents have minds?

A philosophical evaluation worth reading -- here are 3 points:

▪️Some researchers believe AI systems may be conscious, other experts say this is misguided

▪️Calling AI systems “agents” is misleading as it implies the AI systems have agency [strongly agree]

▪️Ultimately, humans are responsible for the outcome of AI systems [strongly agree]
